name: Apple Health
short_desc: External: receive Apple Health data from your iPhone through the Health Auto Export app over Tailscale (read-only for Health). Needs Health Auto Export Premium.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Apple Health has no cloud API, so this app is a private receiver: the third-party iPhone app Health Auto Export (Premium, about $0.99 a month, $5.99 a year or $24.99 once) posts your sleep, heart rate variability, resting heart rate, blood oxygen, Exercise minutes, energy, steps and workouts to your Wizard over Tailscale with a private token. The app's own screen walks you through it with Copy buttons and confirms when data arrives. It keeps a private copy and offers it read-only to other apps on this box through the health-data contract; the Health app shows it. Not affiliated with Apple.
